Explanation:  
The Ground Truth Answer identifies "King Prajadhipok" as the King of Siam during the specified event. The Predicted Answer states that "Vajiravudh (Rama VI)" was the King of Siam at the time of the Wall Street bombing in 1920. Historically, King Vajiravudh (Rama VI) was indeed the King of Siam until 1925, and King Prajadhipok (Rama VII) ascended the throne after 1925. Thus, the Predicted Answer does not contain the Ground Truth Answer (“King Prajadhipok”)—the information is not present and actually contradicts the ground truth.

Decision: FALSE
